sampleCspFinding.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
sampleCspFinding.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and rogue script injection.

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Content-Security-Policy header directive in your Nginx server block.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
# /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-site
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https:;" always;

sampleCspFinding.codeSnippet:

sampleHstsFinding.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
sampleHstsFinding.plainEnglishCause: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS. Users communicating over insecure networks are vulnerable to SSL stripping and man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.
sampleHstsFinding.technicalDetails: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent in response headers.

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to your HTTPS server block in Nginx.

sampleCspFinding.title: Insufficient Color Contrast (WCAG 1.4.3 AA)
sampleCspFinding.plainEnglishCause: Text elements do not meet the minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their background color, making text hard or impossible to read for users with visual impairments.
sampleCspFinding.technicalDetails: Rule: color-contrast (serious). HTML: <button class="cV3TuW_search" data-variant="large" type="button">Search documentation...<kbd>CtrlK</kbd><script type="text/javascript">{var s=document.currentScript,n=s&&s.previousElementSibling;if(n)n.textContent=/^Mac/.test(navigator.platform)?"⌘K":"CtrlK"}</script></button>

fixSteps.instruction: Adjust the foreground text color or background color to satisfy WCAG AA contrast guidelines.

sampleHstsFinding.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
sampleHstsFinding.plainEnglishCause: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS. Users communicating over insecure networks are vulnerable to SSL stripping and man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.
sampleHstsFinding.technicalDetails: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent in response headers.

fixSteps.instruction: [Runtime (python) detected without server header plugin — configure on your web server / reverse proxy] Configure the Strict-Transport-Security HTTP header to require HTTPS connections for at least 1 year.

sampleCspFinding.title: Image Missing Alternative Text (WCAG 1.1.1)
sampleCspFinding.plainEnglishCause: An element does not have an 'alt' attribute. Screen readers cannot describe the image to visually impaired users.
sampleCspFinding.technicalDetails: Found 2 element(s) without an alt attribute.

fixSteps.instruction: Add a descriptive 'alt' attribute to the tag, or alt="" if the image is purely decorative.
